pr_title: TSDB: Fix RollupActionSingleNodeTests failing with IndexNotFoundException
pr_body:
Looks like the failure reported at https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/69799#issuecomment-1144224849 happens because of randomly generated index names conflict between two tests.

- Add more random numbers to test names, so that the probability of conflicts is negligible
- Generate source and rollup index names more carefully so that they are logged properly. 
- Cleanup test code

Fixes #69799
